Torop di tano on mangkaliangi au,

Naeng tarsulandit au di maol ni dalan i.
Hatop ma lao tu Jesus au, pamalum rohangki.
Hubereng ma tongtong Jesusku, tumpalhi,
Ibana tua na tongtong, na so mansohot i.

r: Par-ma-han Je-sus-ki, bi-ru-bi-ru-Na au, Di-to-gu-to-gu ton-ding-ki, ndang be mar-ma-ra au.
Sai di-pa-to-ngon au tu ha-so-na-ngan i. Di-i-ring-i-ring Je-sus au mar-da-lan lao tu-si.
To-rop di ta-no on mang-ka-li-a-ngi au, Sai Tu-han Je-sus do tong-tong ma-ni-op-ni-op au.
Naeng tar-su-lan-dit au di maol ni da-lan i. Ha-top ma lao tu Je-sus au, pa-ma-lum ro-hang-ki.
Hu-be-reng ma tong-tong Je-sus-ku, tum-pal-hi, I-ba-na tu-a na tong-tong, na so man-so-hot i.

rows: Tu-jo-lo ni Tu-han-ku hu-bo-an di-ring-kon;
I-ba-na do Ra-jang-ku, si-gom-gom ro-hang-kon;
Sai gu-ru di I-ba-na su-de-na lang-kang-ki; Sai a-si-ni ro-ha-Na pa-tu-re bo-gas hi.

verses: Tu jolo ni Tuhanku huboan diringkon;
Ibana do Rajangku, sigomgom rohangkon;
Sai guru di Ibana sudena langkangki;
Sai asini rohaNa pature bogas hi.
Ai nang pe au targogot, hutatap Rajangki,
Sai ro do ganup sogot, pangurupiNa i:
Na so pasombuonNa di pangunjunan i,
Sai saut paluaonNa, na hinophopNa i.
Tutu, ndang sai mansohot, tompu na mohop i,
Sipata leleng lohot tu au na dokdok i.
Alai gogongku ganda mamorsan silang i
Tuhanku do hutanda, jonok di lambungki.
Ditiop do tanganku, sai dihehei do au,
Sai tong jonok Tuhanku, ndang dung Ibana dao.
TondiNa patorangkon tu au holongNa i
Sai lam huhadengganhon hansit ni silang i.
Di holong ni rohaNa, dibuhul tingkingki.
Disi do alaponNa au tu lambungNa i.
HolongNa pujionku, tung selelengna i,
Siala sitaonon, niampehonNa i.
title: Tu jolo ni Tuhanku
status: Lirik dicek · 18/20 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Ai nang pe au tar-go-got, hu-ta-tap Ra-jang-ki,
Sai ro do ga-nup so-got, pa-ngu-ru-pi-Na i:
Na so pa-som-bu-on-Na di pa-ngun-ju-nan i, Sai saut pa-lu-a-on-Na, na hi-nop-hop-Na i.
Tu-tu, ndang sai man-so-hot, tom-pu na mo-hop i,
Si-pa-ta le-leng lo-hot tu au na dok-dok i.
A-lai go-gong-ku gan-da ma-mor-san si-lang i Tu-han-ku do hu-tan-da, jo-nok di lam-bung-ki.
Di-ti-op do ta-ngan-ku, sai di-he-hei do au,
Sai tong jo-nok Tu-han-ku, ndang dung I-ba-na dao.
Ton-di-Na pa-to-rang-kon tu au ho-long-Na i Sai lam hu-ha-deng-gan-hon han-sit ni si-lang i.
Di ho-long ni ro-ha-Na, di-bu-hul ting-king-ki.
Di-si do a-la-pon-Na au tu lam-bung-Na i.
Ho-long-Na pu-ji-on-ku, tung se-le-leng-na i, Si-a-la si-ta-o-non, ni-am-pe-hon-Na i.

checks: Birama 4 dicetak "2 . 0" (3 ketuk); not balok buku: not 1/2 bertitik + tanda diam 1/4 → dibaca "2 . . 0".

rows: Hu-som-ba Ho Tu-han, ta-ngi-hon au! Sang-kap-mu ma tong-tong pa-saut tu au; Lam gan-da bae-non Mi ho-long ni ro-hang-ki Sai lam gan-dai ho-long tu Ho

verses: Husomba Ho Tuhan, tangihon au!
Sangkapmu ma tongtong pasaut tu au;
Lam ganda baenon Mi holong ni rohangki
Sai lam gandai holong tu Ho
Uju na lilu au, dao sian Ho, sai dilului Ho au, laos jumpang do.
Ala ni holong do rohangkinon di Ho,
Sai lam gandai holong tu Ho!
Di na targogot au, hansit huae, Ho na mangapul au tu Ho au lao,
Haposanki do Ho, Ho Sipangolu do,
Sai lam tambai holong tu Ho!
Ia tung jumpang ma, ro ajalhi, asi rohaM nama di tondingki;
Na las do rohangki marnida bohiMi
Di lambungMi di surgo i.
title: Husomba Ho Tuhan
status: Lirik dicek · 12/13 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: U-ju na li-lu au, dao si-an Ho, sai di-lu-lui Ho au, laos jum-pang do. A-la ni ho-long do ro-hang-ki-non di Ho, Sai lam gan-dai ho-long tu Ho!
Di na tar-go-got au, han-sit hua-e, Ho na ma-nga-pul au tu Ho au lao, Ha-po-san-ki do Ho, Ho Si-pa-ngo-lu do, Sai lam tam-bai ho-long tu Ho!
I-a tung jum-pang ma, ro a-jal-hi, a-si ro-haM na-ma di ton-ding-ki; Na las do ro-hang-ki mar-ni-da bo-hi-Mi Di lam-bung-Mi di sur-go i.

checks: Pembanding lirik: L10 kata 2 beda ejaan; buku dipakai.

rows: Ja-lo ta-ngan-ku, ti-op au, o Tu-han, ai na ga-le au so mar-do-ngan Ho. Rap do-hot Ho hi-pas do au mar-da-lan. Ma-mo-lus par-ma-ra-an, so-nang do.

verses: Jalo tanganku, tiop au, o Tuhan,
Ai na gale au so mardongan Ho.
Rap dohot Ho hipas do au mardalan.
Mamolus parmaraan, sonang do.
Sai togu au, sihol di Ho rohangku
Naeng lam sumolhot au tu lambungMi.
Ai unang i, mura dope au lilu,
Manimbil sian hasintonganMi
Ajari au, urmun dope huida,
Maol huantusi pambaenMi sude.
Dung pe ro songgop Tondi Parbadia,
Tangkas huida, sasude ture.
Urupi au di ujung ni langkangku,
Mamolus rura hamatean i;
Sai bohiMi panondang di atashu
Laos boan au tu undungundungMi.
title: Jalo tanganku
status: Lirik dicek · 15/16 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai to-gu au, si-hol di Ho ro-hang-ku Naeng lam su-mol-hot au tu lam-bung-Mi. Ai u-nang i, mu-ra do-pe au li-lu, Ma-nim-bil si-an ha-sin-to-ngan-Mi
A-ja-ri au, ur-mun do-pe hu-i-da, Maol huan-tu-si pam-ba-en-Mi su-de. Dung pe ro song-gop Ton-di Par-ba-di-a, Tang-kas hu-i-da, sa-su-de tu-re.
U-ru-pi au di u-jung ni lang-kang-ku, Ma-mo-lus ru-ra ha-ma-te-an i; Sai bo-hi-Mi pa-non-dang di a-tas-hu Laos bo-an au tu un-du-ngun-dung-Mi.

checks: Judul di kepala lagu "Ai beasa tung humolso", tetapi baris pertama lirik "Ho o Tuhan, haholongan ni rohangku".

rows: Ho o Tu-han, ha-ho-lo-ngan ni ro-hang-ku sai tong-tong, sai ta-ngi-hon pa-ngi-do-an, sai u-ru-pi ma au on.

verses: Ho o Tuhan, haholongan ni rohangku sai tongtong,
Sai tangihon pangidoan, sai urupi ma au on.
Pasupasu ulaonku, tumpak ma sudena i,
Sai padenggan ma rohangku maradophon donganki.
Sai patiur ma rohangku mamingkiri basaMi,
Sesa ma sude dosangku, paimbaru todingki.
Iringiring au Tuhanku, sai tiopi tanganki,
Molo tos muse hosangku, abing au tu lambungMi.

status: Lirik dicek · 7/8 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Pa-su-pa-su u-la-on-ku, tum-pak ma su-de-na i, Sai pa-deng-gan ma ro-hang-ku mar-a-dop-hon do-ngan-ki.
Sai pa-ti-ur ma ro-hang-ku ma-ming-ki-ri ba-sa-Mi, Se-sa ma su-de do-sang-ku, pa-im-ba-ru to-ding-ki.
I-ri-ngi-ring au Tu-han-ku, sai ti-o-pi ta-ngan-ki, Mo-lo tos mu-se ho-sang-ku, a-bing au tu lam-bung-Mi.

rows: A-dong do ha-so-na-ngan Di ho par-ja-lang i Ha-top-ma ho-ma-po-rus Tu Tu-han Je-sus i. O, jang-kon ma I-ba-na, a-sa da-po-tan ho, A-dong do ha-so-na-ngan. An-tong sai ro ma ho.

verses: Adong do hasonangan Di ho parjalang i
Hatop ma homaporus Tu Tuhan Jesus i.
O, jangkon ma Ibana, asa dapotan ho,
Adong do hasonangan. Antong sai ro ma ho.
Adong paradianan di ho na loja i,
Di Tuhan Jesus Kristus, pardenggan basa i.
Pareak ma Ibana, ai di paima ho.
Adong paradianan, antong, sai ro ma ho.
Sai parhaseang tingki, halehetanna i.
So tung ho maon mago binaen ni dosami
Unang sai marhusari, unang tarlalap ho.
Adong do hasonangan, antong sai ro ma ho.

status: Lirik dicek · 10/12 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: A-dong par-a-di-a-nan di ho na lo-ja i, Di Tu-han Je-sus Kris-tus, par-deng-gan ba-sa i. Pa-re-ak ma I-ba-na, ai di pai-ma ho. A-dong par-a-di-a-nan, an-tong, sa-i ro ma ho.
Sai par-ha-se-ang ting-ki, ha-le-he-tan-na i. So tung ho ma-on ma-go bi-naen ni do-sa-mi U-nang sai mar-hu-sa-ri, u-nang tar-la-lap ho. A-dong do ha-so-na-ngan, an-tong sai ro ma ho.

Jang-kon au baen si-se-an-Mu, na gir-gir tu po-da-Mi. Sai sur-duk-kon ma ta-ngan-Mu a-sa tong hu-ti-op i.
Tang-kup au Je-sus Tu-han-ku, ti-op au man-sai go-mos, A-sa u-nang run-sur pat-hu si-an da-lan na ting-kos.
Rap-hon Ho do au ma-nga-lo do-sa do-hot hi-sap-hi; Ai su-mu-rut do pa-nga-go, ang-go Ho di lam-bung-ki.
Ton-di-Mi sai tong pa-i-an di au on ti-no-bus-Mi! Tung pa-tau ma au ma-ne-an, pi-nar-ba-ga-ba-ga-Mi.

rows: Je-sus ha-po-san-ku, u-nang ma pa-som-bu au di ha-pun-ju-ngan, di na so-mar-do-ngan Ho tong-tong do-ngan-ku di-par-da-la-nan-ku Je-sus ha-po-san-ku, u-nang au pa-som-bu

verses: Jesus haposanku, unang ma pasombu
Au di hapunjungan, di na somardongan
Ho tongtong donganku dipardalananku
Jesus haposanku, unang au pasombu
Ho sambing Rajangku, Ho do oloanku,
NaposoM do ahu di harajaonMu,
Sonang ma rohangku, dung tangkas di ahu,
Ho sambing Rajangku jala oloanku.
Di harajaonMu tigor do uhumMu.
Ho ma huihuthon lao tu hangoluan,
Naung torang tarida, sonang do nasida
Di harajaonMu ala ni uhumMu.
Masa asi roha mida si pardosa,
Jesus do manesa dosa sasudena,
Na gogo mudarNa mamintori hita;
Angka asi roha, masa di pardosa.
Jesus do Tuhanku, parsigantunganku.
Jesus do ojahan ni haporseaon.
Ndada au tahutau, nang di parmaraan,
Jesus do Tuhanku, parsigantunganku.

r: Ho sam-bing Ra-jang-ku, Ho do o-lo-an-ku, Na-po-soM do a-hu di ha-ra-ja-on-Mu, So-nang ma ro-hang-ku, dung tang-kas di a-hu, Ho sam-bing Ra-jang-ku ja-la o-lo-an-ku.
Di ha-ra-ja-on-Mu ti-gor do u-hum-Mu. Ho ma hu-i-hut-hon lao tu ha-ngo-lu-an, Naung to-rang ta-ri-da, so-nang do na-si-da Di ha-ra-ja-on-Mu a-la ni u-hum-Mu.
Ma-sa a-si ro-ha mi-da si par-do-sa, Je-sus do ma-ne-sa do-sa sa-su-de-na, Na go-go mu-dar-Na ma-min-to-ri hi-ta; Ang-ka a-si ro-ha, ma-sa di par-do-sa.
Je-sus do Tu-han-ku, par-si-gan-tu-ngan-ku. Je-sus do o-ja-han ni ha-por-se-a-on. Nda-da au ta-hu-tau, nang di par-ma-ra-an, Je-sus do Tu-han-ku, par-si-gan-tu-ngan-ku.

rows: Sai mar-tu-a do su-de-na, na so sa-u du-ran i
Do-hot ha-lak na su-mu-rut si-an na por-se-a i,
Na so o-lo ma-ngi-hut-hon ta-hi ni na ja-hat i, na so o-lo sa-hun-du-lan do-hot pa-ngin-sa-hi i.

verses: Sai martua do sudena, na so sau duran i
Dohot halak na sumurut sian na porsea i,
Na so olo mangihuthon tahi ni na jahat i,
na so olo sahundulan dohot panginsahi i.
Sai tongtong lomo rohana, mida pangajaran i,
Na nilehon ni Jahowa, gabe sioloan i.
I do songon hau na denggan na di lambung aek hape.
Sai ramos tongtong Ibana na so olo malos be.
Sai na talu di uhuman halak sipargeduk i;
Jongjong ma di hasangapon, na tigor marroha i;
Sipargeduk ndang na tolhas ro tu hangoluan i,
Hamagoan di nasida, sonang do partigor i.

status: Lirik belum ada pembanding

r: Sai tong-tong lo-mo ro-ha-na, mi-da pa-nga-ja-ran i,
Na ni-le-hon ni Ja-ho-wa, ga-be si-o-lo-an i.
I do so-ngon hau na deng-gan na di lam-bung aek ha-pe. Sai ra-mos tong-tong I-ba-na na so o-lo ma-los be.
Sai na ta-lu di u-hu-man ha-lak si-par-ge-duk i;
Jong-jong ma di ha-sa-nga-pon, na ti-gor mar-ro-ha i;
Si-par-ge-duk ndang na tol-has ro tu ha-ngo-lu-an i, Ha-ma-go-an di na-si-da, so-nang do par-ti-gor i.

rows: Na ma-lu-ngun do ro-hang-ku Mi-da Je-sus, Tu-han-ki,
Ai di-se-sa do do-sang-ku, Di-u-ra-si ro-hang-ki,
Di-ba-ga-san par-sa-hi-tan mar-si-gan-tung au tu Ho, o-lo do au ma-ngi-hut-hon pa-no-gu-on-Mi tu Ho.

verses: Na malungun do rohangku Mida Jesus, Tuhanki,
Ai disesa do dosangku, Diurasi rohangki,
Dibagasan parsahitan marsigantung au tu Ho,
olo do au mangihuthon panoguonMi tu Ho.
Sai palua ma rohangku sian na di tano on,
Asa Ho hangoluanku dohot hasonangankon.
Beta hita tu Ibana, tabege hataNa i,
Holong situtu rohaNa, patut oloanta i.
Sangkap nang pangidoanta dohot na tahirim pe.
Rodi angka pingkiranta di Tuhanta ma sude.
Tapararat ma hataNa tu na so porsea i,
Atik saut dope mardame angka na manjua i.
Molo pos roham di Jesus, tinggal di tanganNa i,
Sonang ma roham, sai tulus do huhut sinangkapMi;
Jadi sai togihononNa ho muse tu surgo i,
Gabe nasa ugasanNa dohot ho manean i.

r: Sai pa-lu-a ma ro-hang-ku si-an na di ta-no on,
A-sa Ho ha-ngo-lu-an-ku do-hot ha-so-na-ngan-kon.
Be-ta hi-ta tu I-ba-na, ta-be-ge ha-ta-Na i, Ho-long si-tu-tu ro-ha-Na, pa-tut o-lo-an-ta i.
Sang-kap nang pa-ngi-do-an-ta do-hot na ta-hi-rim pe.
Ro-di ang-ka ping-ki-ran-ta di Tu-han-ta ma su-de.
Ta-pa-ra-rat ma ha-ta-Na tu na so por-se-a i, A-tik saut do-pe mar-da-me ang-ka na man-ju-a i.
Mo-lo pos ro-ham di Je-sus, ting-gal di ta-ngan-Na i,
So-nang ma ro-ham, sai tu-lus do hu-hut si-nang-kap-Mi;
Ja-di sai to-gi-ho-non-Na ho mu-se tu sur-go i, Ga-be na-sa u-ga-san-Na do-hot ho ma-ne-an i.

Pangidoanku tu Ho, sai tangihon, basabasahon tu au ngoluMi.
Asa di Ho au diharajaonMu,
Lao patulushon, pasauthon hataMu.

Tu pa-mo-dai-Na pa-un-duk ro-ha-mu, A-sa ti-ur sa-su-de bo-gas-mi.
Tang-kup. Tu-han mu, tung ti-op ha-ta-Na, sai pa-nga-sa-hon ma ba-ga-ba-ga-Na.

Na ga-be jol-ma pa-sae-hon do-sa-mu, Go-lom ma, ait-hon pang-hop-hop-Na i.

Pa-ngi-do-an-ku tu Ho, sai ta-ngi-hon, ba-sa-ba-sa-hon tu au ngo-lu-Mi.
A-sa di Ho au di-ha-ra-jaon-Mu, Lao pa-tu-lus-hon, pa-sa-ut-hon ha-ta-Mu.

checks: Birama 3 "2 . 2 v 5": not balok menunjukkan dua not 1/4 (titik hanya pemisah).

rows: Tu-re-na i ma-no-do Tu-han Je-sus, mar-tu-a na pi-nar-ma-han-Na i.
U-li-na i! Sang-kap-na di-pa-tu-lus, di ga-nup hi-ta hi-nop-hop-Na i.
San-dok pa-pu-tus ro-ha-mi: Pa-sa-hat ma di-rim tu Tu-han Je-sus i.

verses: Turena i manodo Tuhan Jesus, martua na pinarmahanNa i.
Ulina i! Sangkapna dipatulus, di ganup hita hinophopNa i.
Sandok paputus rohami:
Pasahat ma dirim tu Tuhan Jesus i.
Sumurung do panogunoguonNa, umarga sian rumang tano on.
Halaean nasa pangajarionNa, dijujur siseanNa i tongon.
Lam las, lam sabam rohangki,
Lam hupasolhot au tu Ho, o Tuhanki.
Ramoti au Tuhanku, sai longkangi, ma sian au tung hatangkangon i.
Asi rohaM, datdati, sai torangi, rohangku, lao mananda dalanMi.
Pangkilalahon ma tu au
GogoM, dameM, ngoluM, tu dia pe au lao.
Ulina i, sai mian di tanganMu, au nang nadokdok niampehonMi.
Ai marsihohot ahu di dalanMu, sai tua i di au tumpahonMi.
Margogo do panatapMi,
Mambuat biar mida hamatean i.
Tahop pe dosa ro, nang halumlamon, manogu au tu haholomon i,
Hutangkup Tuhanki, ai ndang tagamon
Saut lonong au pasombuonna i, jonok Ibana do tongtong,
Asal di au diida roha na sintong.
Sai tong ma au ojak di gomgomanMu, ale Parmahan na sun denggan i.
Anggiat tau au tu hasonanganMu,
Pinaimbaru ni panghophopMi. Marlas ni roha situtu
Au mangihuthon Siparmahan na burju.
title: Turena i manodo
status: Lirik dicek · 21/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Su-mu-rung do pa-no-gu-no-gu-on-Na, um-ar-ga si-an ru-mang ta-no on.
Ha-lae-an na-sa pa-nga-ja-ri-on-Na, di-ju-jur si-se-an-Na i to-ngon.
Lam las, lam sa-bam ro-hang-ki, Lam hu-pa-sol-hot au tu Ho, o Tu-han-ki.
Ra-mo-ti au Tu-han-ku, sai long-ka-ngi, ma si-an au tung ha-tang-ka-ngon i.
A-si ro-haM, dat-da-ti, sai to-ra-ngi, ro-hang-ku, lao ma-nan-da da-lan-Mi.
Pang-ki-la-la-hon ma tu au Go-goM, da-meM, ngo-luM, tu di-a pe au lao.
U-li-na i, sai mi-an di ta-ngan-Mu, au nang na-dok-dok ni-am-pe-hon-Mi.
Ai mar-si-ho-hot a-hu di da-lan-Mu, sai tu-a i di au tum-pa-hon-Mi.
Mar-go-go do pa-na-tap-Mi, Mam-bu-at bi-ar mi-da ha-ma-te-an i.
Ta-hop pe do-sa ro, nang ha-lum-la-mon, ma-no-gu au tu ha-ho-lo-mon i,
Hu-tang-kup Tu-han-ki, ai ndang ta-ga-mon Saut lo-nong au pa-som-bu-on-na i,
jo-nok I-ba-na do tong-tong, A-sal di au di-i-da ro-ha na sin-tong.
Sai tong ma au o-jak di gom-go-man-Mu, a-le Par-ma-han na sun deng-gan i.
Ang-gi-at tau au tu ha-so-na-ngan-Mu, Pi-na-im-ba-ru ni pang-hop-hop-Mi.
Mar-las ni ro-ha si-tu-tu Au ma-ngi-hut-hon Si-par-ma-han na bur-ju.

checks: Judul kepala lagu "O Jesus tatap ma tuson" berbeda dengan baris pertama lirik ("Di rumang ni portibi on").

rows: Di ru-mang ni por-ti-bi on, sai tong do li-lu ro-hang-kon. Hu-ju-jur ha-ti-go-ran-ki, hu-pa-nga-sa-hon bur-jung-ki.

verses: Di rumang ni portibi on, sai tong do lilu rohangkon.
Hujujur hatigoranki, hupangasahon burjungki.
Dung na hutatap Tuhanki, hutanda hahuranganki.
Lam tu balgana i antong, ai lam huboto dangolhon.
Hurangan au di sasude, sipangasahononhon i;
Na so barani rohangkon manaringoti diringkon.
Marhahurangan saluhut, sap dosa do sude huhut;
Ndang na manahan rohangki, di jolo ni Debatangki.
Na gabe tunduk nama au tu Tuhan Jesus do au lao;
Naung mate Ho di Golgata, padomu au tu Debata.
Di tingki ni Tuhanta i do songgop hatiuron i;
Mulai mauas rohangkon tarsunggul do hot rohangkon.
Huhalungunhon hata ni Tuhanku, Sipangolu i.
Na hubege, sai hutohoi mardongan Tuhan huoloi.
Haimbaruon do soluk tu halumlamon na sotuk.
Mardame do huhilala dibaen Jesusku, Debata.
Jesusku, hatigoranki, sasada Ho paheanki,
Saleleng au di tano on nang dung marujung ngolungkon.
Ndang na tarhirim au disi saleleng ni lelengna i.
Asal ngolungku situtu, tung Ho, Tuhanku naburju
title: O Jesus tatap ma tuson
status: Lirik dicek · 16/20 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Dung na hu-ta-tap Tu-han-ki, hu-tan-da ha-hu-ra-ngan-ki. Lam tu bal-ga-na i an-tong, ai lam hu-bo-to da-ngol-hon.
Hu-ra-ngan au di sa-su-de, si-pa-nga-sa-ho-non-hon i; Na so ba-ra-ni ro-hang-kon ma-na-ri-ngo-ti di-ring-kon.
Mar-ha-hu-ra-ngan sa-lu-hut, sap do-sa do su-de hu-hut; Ndang na ma-na-han ro-hang-ki, di jo-lo ni De-ba-tang-ki.
Na ga-be tun-duk na-ma au tu Tu-han Je-sus do au lao; Naung ma-te Ho di Gol-ga-ta, pa-do-mu au tu De-ba-ta.
Di ting-ki ni Tu-han-ta i do song-gop ha-ti-u-ron i; Mu-la-i ma-uas ro-hang-kon tar-sung-gul do hot ro-hang-kon.
Hu-ha-lu-ngun-hon ha-ta ni Tu-han-ku, Si-pa-ngo-lu i. Na hu-be-ge, sai hu-to-hoi mar-do-ngan Tu-han huo-lo-i.
Ha-im-ba-ru-on do so-luk tu ha-lum-la-mon na so-tuk. Mar-da-me do hu-hi-la-la di-baen Je-sus-ku, De-ba-ta.
Je-sus-ku, ha-ti-go-ran-ki, sa-sa-da Ho pa-he-an-ki, Sa-le-leng au di ta-no on nang dung mar-u-jung ngo-lung-kon.
Ndang na tar-hi-rim au di-si sa-le-leng ni le-leng-na i. A-sal ngo-lung-ku si-tu-tu, tung Ho, Tu-han-ku na-bur-ju

rows: Tum-pal hu na um-u-li Ho, o Je-sus-ki di ro-hang-kon; Sai Ho do ti-o-pon-ku. Sa-le-leng au di ta-no on i-nga-ni ma ro-hang-ku.

verses: Tumpalhu na umuli Ho, o Jesuski di rohangkon;
Sai Ho do tioponku. Saleleng au di tano on
Ingani ma rohangku.
Sumurung Ho, o Tuhanki, GoarMu hangoluanki,
Sai i do haposanku nang masa pe bernit muse,
Sai Ho haporusanku.
Haposan do nang hataMi, ai saut pinarbaga na i.
Nang mate, nang mangolu, sai sonang au, nang di na dao,
Ai Ho do Sipangolu.
O Jesuski, dongani au manang tu dia pe au lao,
Sondangi ma rohangku, Ho donganki tu surgo i
Di ujung ni langkangku
title: Tumpalhu na umuli Ho
status: Lirik dicek · 10/12 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Su-mu-rung Ho, o Tu-han-ki, Go-ar-Mu ha-ngo-lu-an-ki, Sai i do ha-po-san-ku nang ma-sa pe ber-nit mu-se, Sai Ho ha-po-ru-san-ku.
Ha-po-san do nang ha-ta-Mi, ai saut pi-nar-ba-ga na i. Nang ma-te, nang ma-ngo-lu, sai so-nang au, nang di na dao, Ai Ho do Si-pa-ngo-lu.
O Je-sus-ki, do-nga-ni au ma-nang tu di-a pe au lao, Son-da-ngi ma ro-hang-ku, Ho do-ngan-ki tu sur-go i Di u-jung ni lang-kang-ku

Di-ja-ga De-ba-tan-ta ma hi-ta on di-si, Aik naeng i-hut-ho-non-ta, par-ro-ha ma-go i Aik naeng i-hut-ho-non-ta, par-ro-ha ma-go i
Si-pil-lit ha-ngo-lu-an, ta-ti-ru ma tong-tong, Hu-hut tu ha-so-na-ngan, u-dur ma hi-ta on. Hu-hut tu ha-so-na-ngan, u-dur ma hi-ta on.

rows: Je-sus Kris-tus do ma-no-bus ha-jol-ma-on sa-su-de, na ni-a-go ni si-bo-lis Di mu-la-na i do-pe, Je-sus Kris-tus do Ra-jan-ta, si-pa-ngo-lu sa-su-de.

verses: Jesus Kristus do manobus hajolmaon sasude,
Na niago ni sibolis di mulana i dope,
Jesus Kristus do Rajanta, sipangolu sasude.
Sipujion do Ibana, ai asi rohaNa i;
Sioloan do hataNa, ai holong rohaNa i
Di pardosa, na tumanda, jea ni rohana be.
Sahat ma tu Ho tondingku, sai ramoti nama au;
Ai na susa do diringku molo au guru di au.
Sai tiopi ma tanganku asa unang mago au.
Sai landit, rahis dalanku, musu pe tongtong godang,
Sundatanna naeng langkangku asa unang au sonang
Sai patulus ma sangkaphu, dalananku baen torang.
Unang loas au be mago, ai tinobusMi do au;
Sai taluhon sipangago asa tu lambungMu au.
Ro di ujung au pamonang sahat baen tu surgo au.
title: Jesus Kristus do manobus
status: Lirik dicek · 13/15 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Si-pu-ji-on do I-ba-na, ai a-si ro-ha-Na i; Si-o-lo-an do ha-ta-Na, ai ho-long ro-ha-Na i Di par-do-sa, na tu-man-da, je-a ni ro-ha-na be.
Sa-hat ma tu Ho ton-ding-ku, sai ra-mo-ti na-ma au; Ai na su-sa do di-ring-ku mo-lo au gu-ru di au. Sai ti-o-pi ma ta-ngan-ku a-sa u-nang ma-go au.
Sai lan-dit, ra-his da-lan-ku, mu-su pe tong-tong go-dang, Sun-da-tan-na naeng lang-kang-ku a-sa u-nang au so-nang Sai pa-tu-lus ma sang-kap-hu, da-la-nan-ku baen to-rang.
U-nang lo-as au be ma-go, ai ti-no-bus-Mi do au; Sai ta-lu-hon si-pa-nga-go a-sa tu lam-bung-Mu au. Ro di u-jung au pa-mo-nang sa-hat baen tu sur-go au.

checks: Pembanding lirik: L20 kata 3 beda ejaan; scan hlm 218 "nang", buku dipakai. Ditemukan lewat indeks /i-2/.

rows: I-hut-hon Au su-de ha-mu! Di-dok Tu-han-ta Je-sus,
Sai so-a-da-hon di-ri-mu, ha-tang-ku ma pa-tu-lus;
A-lai bo-long-kon ma su-de pa-ru-lan-mu na so tu-re.

verses: Ihuthon Au sude hamu! Didok Tuhanta Jesus,
Sai soadahon dirimu, hatangku ma patulus;
Alai bolongkon ma sude parulanmu na so ture.
Sai Au panondang di hamu di dalan hangoluan.
Naeng unang lilu be hamu, dao dohot hamagoan.
Au parhitean di hamu tu hasonangan situtu.
Hupatuduhon di hamu, sipasidingonmuna;
Sude geduk ni rohamu, sipaubaonmuna;
Ai naeng ias ma tondimu di na lao suda bohalmu.
Na serep roha do Au on huhut holong rohangku,
Lambok rohangku ai tongtong na lambok do hatangku.
Tongtong hutatap Debata, i pe Au on ihuthon ma!
Ndang tarpatupa hami i dipingkir rohamuna.
Unang mabiar ala ni, ai Au do donganmuna.
Taluhononku musu i, sai pos ma rohamu disi.
Siparhamaol hosana i, i ma agoan hosa;
Alai na sumeahon i, i do pangoluhonsa,
Na so mamorsan silang i na so tama di Au ma i.
Antong girgir ma hita be lao mangihuthon Jesus,
Dagingta, nang tondinta pe talehon ma tu Jesus;
Ai na manjua Tuhan i ndang dapot hasonangan i.
title: Ihuthon Au sude hamu
status: Lirik dicek · 20/21 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai Au pa-non-dang di ha-mu di da-lan ha-ngo-lu-an.
Naeng u-nang li-lu be ha-mu, dao do-hot ha-ma-go-an.
Au par-hi-te-an di ha-mu tu ha-so-na-ngan si-tu-tu.
Hu-pa-tu-du-hon di ha-mu, si-pa-si-di-ngon-mu-na;
Su-de ge-duk ni ro-ha-mu, si-pa-u-ba-on-mu-na;
Ai naeng i-as ma ton-di-mu di na lao su-da bo-hal-mu.
Na se-rep ro-ha do Au on hu-hut ho-long ro-hang-ku,
Lam-bok ro-hang-ku ai tong-tong na lam-bok do ha-tang-ku.
Tong-tong hu-ta-tap De-ba-ta, i pe Au on i-hut-hon ma!
Ndang tar-pa-tu-pa ha-mi i di-ping-kir ro-ha-mu-na.
U-nang ma-bi-ar a-la ni, ai Au do do-ngan-mu-na.
Ta-lu-ho-non-ku mu-su i, sai pos ma ro-ha-mu di-si.
Si-par-ha-maol ho-sa-na i, i ma a-go-an ho-sa;
A-lai na su-me-a-hon i, i do pa-ngo-lu-hon-sa,
Na so ma-mor-san si-lang i na so ta-ma di Au ma i.
An-tong gir-gir ma hi-ta be lao ma-ngi-hut-hon Je-sus,
Da-ging-ta, nang ton-din-ta pe ta-le-hon ma tu Je-sus;
Ai na man-ju-a Tu-han i ndang da-pot ha-so-na-ngan i.

checks: Birama "3 ' 6 5": not balok mencetak 3 sebagai 1/2 (angka tanpa titik), ditulis "3 ." agar 4 ketuk.
Birama akhir tercetak "3 2̇ i̇ ." (titik di atas), tetapi not balok G4–F4 (oktaf tengah); ditulis 2 dan 1 tanpa oktaf atas.
Pembanding lirik: L7 kata 3 dan L23 kata 5 beda ejaan; buku dipakai.

rows: Bin-san ro-a-si ni ro-ha ni Tu-han-ta i di ho, a-lo ma di-rim, pa-bo-a jo-ra si-tu-tu do ho.

verses: Binsan ro asi ni roha ni Tuhanta i di ho,
Alo ma dirim, paboa jora situtu do ho.
Sai tundali nasa jea sai tahopi Debata,
Tanda na tutu porsea ho di Tuhan Debata.
Ia dalan hangoluan na gogot tutu do i
Unang ho marhamaluan, tagam nasa musumi.
Anggo dalan hamagoan na lambas tutu do i:
Tung tu api do diboan na disi dirina i.
Sai papos roham mangalo alo dosami gogo,
Asa unang ho na talu, unang na sumurut ho.
Angkup ni sai martangiang asa ganda gogomi,
Jala sai tongtong ho sirang sian angka musumi.
Unang sai matamatahon arta na di tano on,
Jaga ma roham salahon roha ni portibi on.
Hisapmi tongtong pompomi, sai patunduk dagingmi,
Asa unang diintopi dosa i palitomi.
Sai momosi ma luhutna naung hinamonangkonmi,
Unang loas be malua, ai mansai jorbut do i.
Ia dung dapotan uli ho, sai unang tois roham,
Ai ndang sahat dope muli tondimi tu banuam.
Sasude na burju roha mangihuthon Jesus i,
Sai dialo do musuna, paima tos hosana i.
Dirimu do musumuna dohot sipangago i;
Ia hangoluanmuna, i ma Tuhan Jesus i
title: Binsan ro asi ni roha
status: Lirik dicek · 22/24 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai tun-da-li na-sa je-a sai ta-ho-pi De-ba-ta, Tan-da na tu-tu por-se-a ho di Tu-han De-ba-ta.
I-a da-lan ha-ngo-lu-an na go-got tu-tu do i U-nang ho mar-ha-ma-lu-an, ta-gam na-sa mu-su-mi.
Ang-go da-lan ha-ma-go-an na lam-bas tu-tu do i: Tung tu a-pi do di-bo-an na di-si di-ri-na i.
Sai pa-pos ro-ham ma-nga-lo a-lo do-sa-mi go-go, A-sa u-nang ho na ta-lu, u-nang na su-mu-rut ho.
Ang-kup ni sai mar-ta-ngi-ang a-sa gan-da go-go-mi, Ja-la sai tong-tong ho si-rang si-an ang-ka mu-su-mi.
U-nang sai ma-ta-ma-ta-hon ar-ta na di ta-no on, Ja-ga ma ro-ham sa-la-hon ro-ha ni por-ti-bi on.
Hi-sap-mi tong-tong pom-po-mi, sai pa-tun-duk da-ging-mi, A-sa u-nang di-in-to-pi do-sa i pa-li-to-mi.
Sai mo-mo-si ma lu-hut-na naung hi-na-mo-nang-kon-mi, U-nang lo-as be ma-lu-a, ai man-sai jor-but do i.
I-a dung da-po-tan u-li ho, sai u-nang tois ro-ham, Ai ndang sa-hat do-pe mu-li ton-di-mi tu ba-nu-am.
Sa-su-de na bur-ju ro-ha ma-ngi-hut-hon Je-sus i, Sai di-a-lo do mu-su-na, pai-ma tos ho-sa-na i.
Di-ri-mu do mu-su-mu-na do-hot si-pa-nga-go i; I-a ha-ngo-lu-an-mu-na, i ma Tu-han Je-sus i

checks: Judul kepala lagu "Ngot ma ho dijou soara" berbeda dengan baris pertama lirik ("O hamuna, na porsea").
Nama komponis dicetak "Philipp Nocolai" (ejaan lazim: Philipp Nicolai).

Pembanding lirik: L6 kata 3 beda ejaan; buku dipakai.

rows: O-ha-mu-na, na por-se-a, sai tong ha-mu ma-nga-lo-je-a, u-ti-an ni pa-nga-go-i.
Ha-ta ni De-ba-ta-mu-na, ma baen ha-mu sin-ja-ta-mu-na, ndang ta-lu be ha-mu di-si
Bi-suk pe mu-su i, di-tan-da ro-ha-mi, jou ma Je-sus. Sai mo-nang do bae-non-Na ho, a-lai mu-sun-ta ta-lu do.

verses: O hamuna, na porsea, sai tong hamu mangalojea, utian ni pangagoi.
Hata ni Debatamuna, ma baen hamu sinjatamuna, ndang talu be hamu disi
Bisuk pe musu i, ditanda rohami, jou ma Jesus.
Sai monang do baenonNa ho, alai musunta talu do.
Sai paias rohamuna huhut sai alo hisapmuna,
Ai halak Kristen do hamu, sai papos ma rohamuna
Di Tuhan Jesus Rajamuna, ai urupanNa do hamu,
Naeng suda pe gogom sai tatap sambulom, na di ginjang
Sonang disi tondinta i, dung sahat hita ro disi.
Ale Jesus, pargogoi ma nasa jolma, sioloi
HataM di hasiangan on, paimbaru rohanami,
Huhut papir ma tondinami, ai na gale do hami on.
Tu rohanami be, pasaor ma TondiMi na badia.
Sai burju be di Ho sude, mangolu manang mate pe
title: Ngot ma ho dijou soara
status: Lirik dicek · 13/14 baris sama dgn pembanding

r: Sai pa-i-as ro-ha-mu-na hu-hut sai a-lo hi-sap-mu-na, Ai ha-lak Kris-ten do ha-mu,
sai pa-pos ma ro-ha-mu-na Di Tu-han Je-sus Ra-ja-mu-na, ai u-ru-pan-Na do ha-mu,
Naeng su-da pe go-gom sai ta-tap sam-bu-lom, na di gin-jang So-nang di-si ton-din-ta i, dung sa-hat hi-ta ro di-si.
A-le Je-sus, par-go-go-i ma na-sa jol-ma, si-o-lo-i Ha-taM di ha-si-a-ngan on,
pa-im-ba-ru ro-ha-na-mi, Hu-hut pa-pir ma ton-di-na-mi, ai na ga-le do ha-mi on.
Tu ro-ha-na-mi be, pa-saor ma Ton-di-Mi na ba-di-a. Sai bur-ju be di Ho su-de, ma-ngo-lu ma-nang ma-te pe
